summary: 2026-07-24 08:30:03 PDT — The implementation is functionally aligned with the guarded check → commit → mutate flow, but the AC6 transition lacks meaningful regression coverage and the required warning text differs slightly from the specification. The test/build gate could not execute because the read-only sandbox prevented Vite from creating temporary files; `git diff --check` passed.

findings.title: AC6 test does not exercise notice clearing
findings.claim: The test supplies `overlayNotice: null` directly and verifies only that PresenterControls conditionally omits the warning. It never performs a blocked attempt followed by a successful attempt or observes the App wrapper clearing its existing notice. Deleting `setOverlayNotice(null)` from App.jsx would therefore leave all added tests passing while breaking AC6.
findings.suggestion: Add a testable seam for applying an attempt result to the overlay UI state, use it from `startOverlay`, and test the blocked→successful sequence to verify that an existing notice is cleared and `overlayOn` becomes true.

findings.title: Warning text does not exactly match the specified copy
findings.claim: AC2 specifies `Turn your camera on, then click 'Show cost on video'.`, but the implementation renders double quotation marks around the button label. Both required steps remain understandable, so the impact is only a copy mismatch.
findings.suggestion: Change the constant and corresponding test fixture to use the exact single-quoted wording from AC2.
